module: JUnit XML test result writer for testFramework/TestManager. Builds a DOM (testsuites > testsuite > testcase, with a failure element for each failed test) with libs/slaxml/slaxdom, serializes it with 2-space indentation and writes it with writeFile.
notes: The suite name is `suiteName`, or `results.suiteName`, or "LuaUnitTests" by default.
A failed test carries a <failure type="ExpectedFailure"|"Failure"> element whose text is errorMessage.
Called by TestManager:run only if options.writeXml == true and an output file is given.

write.desc: Writes the test results to a JUnit XML file and logs the path.

results.desc: {testResults = {{name, duration, passed, expectedToFail, errorMessage}}, testFailCount, totalDuration, suiteName?}.
